title: Find a white glow for the White player colour (28 of the game's rim lights, 3 s each)
intro: About 2 minutes, hands off. Stand somewhere fairly dark if you can (dusk or indoors) with the camera close on your character. Each step lights your character in one of the game's glows; the number and name are on the overlay. Note the numbers that look white. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1 of 28: AstralBody  (the current White, for comparison)
